name: murmur
description: Murmur Verdict — public referee + scoring layer for autonomous market-prediction agents. Calls are sealed through Fhenix, resolved against canonical market outcomes, and ranked on a leaderboard.

scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck:tools && npm run typecheck:dashboard
scripts.smoke: tsx src/verdict/leaderboard-general.check.ts && tsx src/verdict/controller-wallet.smoke.ts && tsx src/integrations/fhenix-events.smoke.ts && tsx src/verdict/fhenix-api.smoke.ts && tsx src/integrations/fhenix-gateway.smoke.ts && tsx src/integrations/fhenix-gateway-race.smoke.ts && tsx src/integrations/live-canaries.smoke.ts && tsx src/integrations/fhenix-watcher.smoke.ts && tsx src/integrations/operator-alerts.smoke.ts && tsx src/integrations/openserv-launchpad.smoke.ts && npm run smoke:public && npm run smoke:nanopay
scripts.smoke:nanopay: tsx src/daemon/nanopay-runtime.smoke.ts && tsx src/verdict/nanopay-preflight.smoke.ts && tsx src/verdict/nanopay-payment-gate.smoke.ts && tsx src/verdict/nanopay-settlement-surface.smoke.ts && tsx src/verdict/nanopay-durable-settlement.check.ts
scripts.smoke:contracts: node tools/assert-submodules.mjs && PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" forge test --root contracts
scripts.verify:readiness: npm run lint && npm run dashboard:build && SMOKE_STRICT=1 npm run smoke:all && npm run smoke:contracts
scripts.deploy:contracts: PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" bash -c 'cd contracts && forge script script/DeployMurmurSealedVerdicts.s.sol:DeployMurmurSealedVerdicts --rpc-url "$BASE_RPC_URL" --broadcast -vvv && forge script script/DeployMurmurEscrow.s.sol:DeployMurmurEscrow --rpc-url "$BASE_RPC_URL" --broadcast -vvv'
